purpose: Original Torch arange/exponent/pow windows at global indices. Each window begins at a global multiple of32 and contains either a full32-element prefix or the complete final tail. This avoids allocating huge tensors while preserving original AVX2 arange base/offset and AVX512 pow prefix membership. These are operator diagnostics, not additional complete original LlamaModel generator outputs.
format: HIDX0001 u32 count; each <qQdI> dimension, global start index, theta, elements then arange/exponent/power F32LE arrays.
